svg.title: ChatGPT-TitleSync: Windows 10-style title illustration
svg.desc: Illustration, not a screenshot. Identical gray taskbars and system styling before and after; only plain caption text changes. Full sources: Example chat A — ChatGPT, Example chat B — ChatGPT, Example chat C — ChatGPT. Long titles are ellipsized in narrow buttons.

g.text: Full title example: Example chat A — ChatGPT
Illustration only. The program changes plain window-title text.
Windows controls button width, font, grouping and theme; narrow buttons truncate long titles.
